title: salix pyrifolia var. lanceolata
intro: Salix pyrifolia var. lanceolata, commonly known as Korean white willow, is a plant species in the willow family (Salicaceae) known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects, making it useful in the treatment of pain, fever, and rheumatic conditions. The therapeutic actions of Korean white willow are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as salicin, which has a similar structure to aspirin and provides relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Salix pyrifolia var. lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
